# Pair audit - every card, read once, in one of two states

<!-- Generated by the source package's build tools from the cards and from
     the source package's build tools Do not edit by hand: the next build
     overwrites it, and every number here is measured rather than typed. -->

Every card in an audited family ends in exactly one of two states, and the check
`card-pair-unaudited` fails on any card that is in neither. **That is what turns
"every card was read" from a claim into arithmetic.**

```
have an alternative    3340   they carry a `Yields to:` field
have none              1422   they are listed below, by reason
                      -----
                       4762
```

Audited so far: **108 of 108 families**, holding 4,762 of the 4,762 in the package.

**The two counts are read off the cards, not off the reports.** A report is one
reader's claim; the package is the fact.

**41 cards carry a pair field that a reader filed as no-pair** - the claim being
that what sits in the slot is a pointer, a companion or an execution note rather
than an alternative. Nothing was removed and no winner was picked; they are
counted as having a pair, because the package says they have one.
